The **universal APK** works across supported Android devices and is the recommended download. Choose an ABI-specific APK only if you know your device architecture.

## ✅ Install

1. Download the universal APK, or the matching ABI APK for your device.
2. Allow your browser or file manager to install apps from this source if Android asks.
3. Open the downloaded APK and follow Android's install prompt.
